capabilities: Chat with notes using grounded RAG with inline citations that link to source chunks
Index Markdown, PDF, DOCX, XLSX and PPTX files in a Web Worker
Retrieve via hybrid BM25, vector embeddings and document summaries fused with reciprocal rank fusion
Read images through Tesseract OCR and optional LLM vision
Generate summaries, study guides, timelines, FAQs, mind maps and PowerPoint slide decks from folders
disambiguation: Not a general chatbot plugin; answers are grounded in indexed vault content with jump-to-source citations.
extras: Desktop-only (mobile out of scope due to embedding worker and WASM requirements). Pre-1.0; currently installed manually from release files, with community-listing availability pending registry sync. Advanced usage documented separately in docs/USAGE.md. No telemetry; indexes stored as JSONL under the plugin folder.
intentEvidence: Inspired by Google NotebookLM but fully local-first and provider-agnostic
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to ask questions across your notes and get answers grounded in cited sources, or to turn a folder of notes into structured documents.

relations.evidence: Inspired by Google NotebookLM but fully local-first and provider-agnostic

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible provider API key (DeepSeek, Moonshot/Kimi, GLM, Qwen, OpenAI, ...)

summary: AI assistant that chats with your vault using grounded RAG with citations, and generates study guides, timelines, mind maps and slide decks from folders.
